nodes.label: Background Mark: gold line-art winged justice figure (page watermark)
nodes.description: Decorative UI asset, not a screenshot. Single-colour gold/amber outline drawing on a transparent background: a fairy-like female figure in profile with large leaf/butterfly-shaped wings and long flowing tail ribbons, holding a balance scale in her outstretched hand. No text. Used as the glowing background watermark behind the app pages.

nodes.label: Scales of Justice motif (legal-team branding)
nodes.rationale: The balance scale held by the figure signals the legal domain of the task manager; the thin single-colour line style keeps it faint enough to sit behind glass-style UI content.
